tabs.html:
MikroTik CCR2004-16G-2S+ – High-Performance Cloud Core Router for Enterprise & ISP Networks

Powerful 10G Cloud Core Router for Advanced Networking

The MikroTik CCR2004-16G-2S+ is a high-performance Cloud Core Router, designed for ISP networks, large enterprises, data centers, and high-traffic applications. Powered by an Annapurna Labs Alpine v2 CPU (Quad-Core ARMv8-A Cortex-A57, 1.7GHz), 4GB DDR4 RAM, and 128MB NAND storage, this router ensures exceptional performance, stability, and efficiency.


With 16 x Gigabit Ethernet ports and 2 x SFP+ (10Gbps) fiber ports, the CCR2004-16G-2S+ provides high-speed connectivity, advanced routing, firewall protection, and VPN support, making it ideal for high-bandwidth and mission-critical networking environments.


Key Features 

  • High-Performance Annapurna Labs CPU – Quad-Core ARMv8-A Cortex-A57 (1.7GHz per core) ensures fast data processing.
  • Enterprise-Grade Connectivity – Equipped with 16 x Gigabit LAN ports and 2 x 10Gbps SFP+ ports for ultra-fast networking.
  • RouterOS L6 (v7 Only) – Supports advanced routing, firewall, VLAN, VPN, and network management features.
  • 4GB DDR4 RAM & 128MB NAND Storage – Ensures fast, reliable, and efficient data handling.
  • Dual Redundant Power Supply – Provides high availability and reliability for continuous operation.
  • 1U Rackmount Case – Compact rack-mountable design for easy deployment in data centers and enterprise environments.
  • Fanless Cooling – Efficient passive cooling ensures silent and reliable operation.
  • Made in Europe – Manufactured by MikroTik in Lithuania or Latvia, ensuring top-tier quality and durability.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Peace of mind with a one-year manufacturer warranty.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CCR2004-16G-2S+
  • CPU: Annapurna Labs Alpine v2 (Quad-Core ARMv8-A Cortex-A57, 1.7GHz per core)
  • RAM: 4GB DDR4
  • Storage: 128MB NAND
  • Ethernet Ports: 16 x Gigabit LAN
  • SFP+ Ports: 2 x 10Gbps Fiber Ports
  • Operating System: RouterOS L6 (v7 Only)
  • Power Supply: Dual Redundant Power Supply
  • Enclosure: 1U Rackmount Case
  • Manufacturing Origin: Lithuania or Latvia
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • ISP & Data Centers – Designed for high-speed, high-bandwidth environments.
  • Enterprise Networks – Handles large-scale networking and cloud applications.
  • Fiber & High-Speed Internet Deployment – Supports 10Gbps fiber connections.
  • VPN & Secure Network Management – Advanced firewall, VLAN, and VPN support.
  • Mission-Critical Infrastructure – Dual redundant power supplies ensure maximum uptime.


Why Choose MikroTik CCR2004-16G-2S+?

  • Ultra-Fast Routing & Switching – 16 Gigabit LAN & 2 x 10G SFP+ ports for blazing-fast connectivity.
  • Enterprise-Grade Hardware – High-performance Annapurna Labs CPU & DDR4 RAM.
  • Reliable & Redundant – Dual power supply & fanless cooling for durability.
  • Ideal for High-Traffic Networks – Perfect for ISPs, businesses, and cloud services.
